list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exact charges and allocation boundaries
panels.description: Balances and aggregate fee charts use whole native units (10^18 wei), with deployment-specific currency labels and no price conversion. Exact detail tables and per-gas prices remain in gwei. Execution and blob fees add to the displayed total. L1 configured-wallet fees, posting fees and selected receipts are overlapping populations; do not add their panels together. L2 user fees remain separate. Included reverts are charged; missing accounting remains unknown. Tables preserve exact decimal gwei values. Shared posting overhead uses equal_share_v1 estimates, not exact per-user charges.

options.content: Balances and aggregate fee charts use whole native units (10^18 wei), with deployment-specific currency labels and no price conversion. Exact detail tables and per-gas prices remain in gwei. Execution and blob fees add to the displayed total. L1 configured-wallet fees, posting fees and selected receipts are overlapping populations; do not add their panels together. L2 user fees remain separate. Included reverts are charged; missing accounting remains unknown. Tables preserve exact decimal gwei values. Shared posting overhead uses equal_share_v1 estimates, not exact per-user charges.

panels.title: Configured L1 wallets · execution, blobs and total fees · selected range
panels.description: Sum of canonical included receipt fees for the configured L1 wallets in the selected time range, including reverts. Total = execution + blobs. Does not include transferred value, L2 user fees or unrelated wallets. Unknown if the selected population has incomplete fee accounting. Amounts use whole L1 native units (wei / 10^18), not a currency-price conversion. Do not add these totals to overlapping posting or selected-receipt panels.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS execution_native,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS blob_native,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS total_native FROM eez.wallet_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND c.role='l1'

panels.title: Poster balance over time · native units
panels.description: Observed balance of the configured L1 poster account. One whole native unit equals 10^18 wei. Currency labels come from deployment configuration; no asset or fiat conversion. Shows retained Prometheus samples, including funding increases and spending decreases, from when collection began. Missing/invalid samples remain gaps. This configured-account panel uses environment/deployment scope, independently of the native-instance, source-chain and rollup selectors. It does not reconstruct older balances from spending or identify the runtime signer automatically.

panels.title: Configured-wallet fees · native units / 5m
panels.description: Canonical included fees per five-minute bucket in whole native units (wei / 10^18). Includes reverted receipts. Execution and blob fees are separate components; total is their sum, never a third charge to add. Incomplete accounting suppresses the entire bucket. Missing buckets remain absent. This population overlaps other spend panels and must not be added to them. Exact decimal gwei amounts remain in the tables below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text||' · 0x'||encode(r.sender,'hex') AS metric,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS value FROM eez.wallet_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Posting fees · execution, blobs and total · native units / 5m
panels.description: Canonical included fees per five-minute bucket in whole native units (wei / 10^18). Includes reverted receipts. Execution and blob fees are separate components; total is their sum, never a third charge to add. Incomplete accounting suppresses the entire bucket. Missing buckets remain absent. This population overlaps other spend panels and must not be added to them. Exact decimal gwei amounts remain in the tables below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text||CASE WHEN r.success THEN ' · successful' ELSE ' · reverted' END AS metric,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS execution_native,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS blob_native,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS total_native FROM eez.posting_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Selected receipt fees · execution, blobs and total · native units / 5m
panels.description: Canonical included fees per five-minute bucket in whole native units (wei / 10^18). Includes reverted receipts. Execution and blob fees are separate components; total is their sum, never a third charge to add. Incomplete accounting suppresses the entire bucket. Missing buckets remain absent. This population overlaps other spend panels and must not be added to them. Exact decimal gwei amounts remain in the tables below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS execution_native,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS blob_native,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS total_native FROM eez.canonical_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Configured account balances · current native units
panels.description: Current configured observer accounts for the selected environment/deployment, kept separate by account, chain role and observer instance. Balance refers to its verified canonical anchor. SQL chain/rollup/source-hash and Native instance filters do not select these configured accounts. Display values are approximate native units, not fiat.

panels.title: Configured account runway · positive covered burn
panels.description: Current observer account runway from a fully covered positive canonical spend window. Zero burn, missing history, stale balances and changed cursors remain Unknown. All configured roles in the selected environment/deployment are shown; accounts are not inferred from native signing identities.

panels.title: Actual runtime poster · candidate reserve covered
panels.description: Exact native comparison for a recently observed actual poster candidate. Requires fresh estimate and balance flags. An insufficient blob-only minimum also proves Not fundable; it does not estimate execution gas. These signing accounts are independent of observer-configured addresses. No current candidate is Unknown.

targets.expr: reth_eez_poster_can_fund_candidate{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) (reth_eez_poster_funding_estimate_valid{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1) and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) (reth_eez_poster_funding_balance_valid{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1) and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) ((time() - reth_eez_poster_funding_estimate_timestamp_seconds{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) <= 90) and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) ((time() - reth_eez_poster_funding_estimate_timestamp_seconds{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) >= -5) and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) (up{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1)

panels.title: Configured funding coverage · current evidence
panels.description: Evidence validity for current configured accounts. Zero means unavailable/unknown, including zero observed burn; it does not mean zero balance or unlimited runway. Chain roles and account roles remain separate. Inspect funding error/burn_unknown metrics and the funding runbook for the cause.

panels.title: Configured wallet spend · separate chain populations
panels.description: Configured payer identity defines wallet spend independently of source/companion attribution. Exact sums from canonical receipt inclusions. Sums include known charges only; any incomplete-receipt count means the complete population total is unknown. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.role,c.chain_id::text,'0x'||encode(r.sender,'hex') AS wallet,count(*) AS receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT r.success) AS reverted_receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_receipts,trim_scale((sum(r.execution_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_execution_paid_gwei,trim_scale((sum(r.blob_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_blob_paid_gwei,trim_scale((sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_total_paid_gwei FROM eez.wallet_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY c.role,c.chain_id,r.sender ORDER BY c.role

panels.title: Paid posting calls · successful versus reverted
panels.description: Per paid posting call, not per source or successful applied batch. Exact known sum and decimal per-call mean; incomplete receipts suppress the mean. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.success,count(*) AS calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_calls,trim_scale((sum(r.execution_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_execution_paid_gwei,trim_scale((sum(r.blob_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_blob_paid_gwei,trim_scale((sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_total_paid_gwei,trim_scale((CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)/NULLIF(count(*),0) END) * 0.000000001)::text AS mean_paid_per_call_gwei FROM eez.posting_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY r.success

panels.title: Daily selected receipt spend · chain-separated
panels.description: Configured selected receipt population, daily UTC buckets in the selected time range. Source dependencies outside original selection are excluded from this bill. Sums include known charges only; any incomplete-receipt count means the complete population total is unknown. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision)) AS day,c.role,c.chain_id::text,count(*) AS receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_receipts,trim_scale((sum(r.execution_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_execution_paid_gwei,trim_scale((sum(r.blob_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_blob_paid_gwei,trim_scale((sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_total_paid_gwei FROM eez.canonical_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Receipt detail · optional transaction hash
panels.description: One current canonical inclusion per transaction; exact decimal gwei values stay strings to avoid floating-point loss. A source receipt proves only source inclusion/status. Explorer links are added only for configured explorer URLs. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) AS time,c.role,c.chain_id::text,'0x'||encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex') AS transaction,'0x'||encode(r.block_hash,'hex') AS inclusion_block,r.transaction_index::text,r.success,r.gas_used::text,trim_scale((r.effective_gas_price) * 0.000000001)::text AS effective_gas_price_gwei,r.blob_gas_used::text,trim_scale((r.blob_gas_price) * 0.000000001)::text AS blob_gas_price_gwei,trim_scale((r.execution_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS execution_paid_gwei,trim_scale((r.blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS blob_paid_gwei,trim_scale((r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS total_paid_gwei,r.accounting_gap,CASE c.role WHEN 'l1' THEN __EEZ_L1_EXPLORER_SQL__ WHEN 'l2' THEN __EEZ_L2_EXPLORER_SQL__ END AS explorer_url FROM eez.canonical_receipt_facts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) ORDER BY r.timestamp_seconds DESC,r.transaction_index LIMIT 200

panels.title: Posting allocation coverage · per rollup context
panels.description: Canonical posting population per L2 context, including unallocated reasons and accounting gaps. Context rows can overlap: do not add their posting costs across rollups. Missing evidence is not a zero-cost source. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged.

targets.rawSql: WITH scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.chain_instance_id AS l1,l2.chain_instance_id AS l2 FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.deployment_id=c.deployment_id AND l2.role='l2' WHERE c.role='l1' AND c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring})), allocation AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.* FROM eez.posting_allocation_status r WHERE (r.chain_instance_id,r.l2_chain_id) IN (SELECT l1,l2 FROM scope)) SELECT l2.chain_instance_id::text AS l2_context,l2.rollup_id::text,r.allocation_state,count(*) AS posting_calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_receipts,trim_scale((sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_posting_cost_gwei FROM allocation r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY l2.chain_instance_id,l2.rollup_id,r.allocation_state ORDER BY l2.chain_instance_id,r.allocation_state

panels.title: Indexed receipt coverage

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.role,c.chain_id::text,c.rollup_id::text,v.indexed_from::text,v.indexed_through::text,v.incomplete_blocks,v.last_success_at,v.collection_error,v.frozen_reason FROM eez.index_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) ORDER BY c.role

panels.title: Posting classification coverage · full indexed interval
panels.description: Decoded posting panels and blob coverage exclude unknown/invalid methods. This lifetime indexed-interval coverage is shown beside them; it is not limited to the dashboard time window. Unknown method rows do not become zero paid costs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.role,v.tracked_contract_receipts,v.decoded_post_receipts,v.invalid_post_calldata_receipts,v.other_method_receipts,v.unknown_method_receipts,v.method_collection_errors,v.last_method_attempt_at,v.source_valid FROM eez.posting_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring})

panels.title: Shared posting overhead estimates · per source
panels.description: equal_share_v1 divides exact execution/blob fees over unique native attempt sources, including paid failed attempts. Integer remainders follow deterministic source order. These are estimates of shared overhead; summing the allocated components reproduces each paid post once. Source receipts remain separate. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged.

targets.rawSql: WITH scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.chain_instance_id AS l1,l2.chain_instance_id AS l2 FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.deployment_id=c.deployment_id AND l2.role='l2' WHERE c.role='l1' AND c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring})), allocation AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.* FROM eez.source_posting_allocations r WHERE (r.l1_chain_id,r.l2_chain_id) IN (SELECT l1,l2 FROM scope)) SELECT to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) AS time,'0x'||encode(r.post_hash,'hex') AS posting_transaction,'0x'||(r.source->>'transaction_hash') AS source_transaction,r.source->>'direction' AS direction,r.source->>'chain_id' AS source_chain_id,r.success AS post_success,r.member_count,r.allocation_rule,r.evidence_class,trim_scale((r.allocated_execution_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS estimated_execution_gwei,trim_scale((r.allocated_blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS estimated_blob_gwei,trim_scale((r.allocated_execution_paid+r.allocated_blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS estimated_total_gwei FROM allocation r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=r.l1_chain_id JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR r.source->>'transaction_hash'=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x','')) OR encode(r.post_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) ORDER BY r.timestamp_seconds DESC,r.post_hash,r.allocation_position LIMIT 200

panels.title: Attributed L1 companion receipts · exact charges
panels.description: Receipt-level deduplicated native companion relationships require exact source/post inclusion and an unambiguous rollup window. Reverts remain charged. This population may overlap configured wallet spend and must not be added to it as another bill. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) AS time,'0x'||encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex') AS source_transaction,'0x'||encode(r.post_hash,'hex') AS posting_transaction,'0x'||encode(r.block_hash,'hex') AS inclusion_block,r.success,trim_scale((r.execution_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS execution_paid_gwei,trim_scale((r.blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS blob_paid_gwei,trim_scale((r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS total_paid_gwei,r.accounting_gap,r.evidence_class FROM eez.companion_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.context_l2 WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x','')) OR encode(r.post_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) ORDER BY r.timestamp_seconds DESC,r.transaction_index LIMIT 200

panels.title: Completed sources · known attributed posting cost
panels.description: Distinct scoped sources currently verified committed, grouped by their first retained canonical reconciliation watermark in the selected time range. Known lifetime posting allocations include paid retries. The integer-floor mean uses only sources with allocation evidence; missing populations and unallocated posting fees are reported separately. This is a partial attributed posting-cost estimate, excluding direct source receipts and L2 fees. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged. Existing per-source/per-transaction floors are applied in integer wei before conversion to gwei; they are not rounded down to whole gwei.

targets.rawSql: WITH scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.chain_instance_id AS l1,l2.chain_instance_id AS l2 FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.deployment_id=c.deployment_id AND l2.role='l2' WHERE c.role='l1' AND c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring})), cohort AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT o.context_l1,o.context_l2,o.source,min(o.progress_timestamp_seconds) AS first_watermark FROM eez.lifecycle_canonical_outcomes o JOIN scope ON scope.l1=o.context_l1 AND scope.l2=o.context_l2 WHERE o.evidence_class='node_reconciled' AND o.outcome='committed' AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR o.source->>'transaction_hash'=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) GROUP BY o.context_l1,o.context_l2,o.source HAVING to_timestamp(min(o.progress_timestamp_seconds)::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()), attributed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.context_l1,c.context_l2,c.source,count(*) AS paid_posts,sum(a.allocated_execution_paid+a.allocated_blob_paid) AS known_posting_cost FROM cohort c JOIN eez.source_posting_allocations a ON a.l1_chain_id=c.context_l1 AND a.l2_chain_id=c.context_l2 AND a.source=c.source GROUP BY c.context_l1,c.context_l2,c.source) SELECT c.source->>'direction' AS direction,count(*) AS committed_sources,count(a.paid_posts) AS sources_with_allocation,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.paid_posts IS NULL) AS sources_without_allocation,trim_scale((sum(a.known_posting_cost)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_attributed_posting_gwei,trim_scale((div(sum(a.known_posting_cost),NULLIF(count(a.paid_posts),0))) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_posting_per_measured_source_gwei FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN attributed a ON a.context_l1=c.context_l1 AND a.context_l2=c.context_l2 AND a.source=c.source GROUP BY c.source->>'direction'

panels.title: Settled L2 transactions · measured posting cost
panels.description: Exact first-applied L2 transaction population from complete all-transaction scans and canonical applied hashes. Repeated/overlapping ranges count a transaction once; successful and reverted L2 transactions both count. Requires retained history from genesis to rule out prior settlement; partial bootstrap, historical prefix, receipt and classification gaps remain unknown. Ratio uses covered posting fees, including reverted posts, divided by known newly settled transactions in the selected posting-time window. It excludes unknown-cost/population posts, companions and L2 user fees; coverage counts accompany it. Zero transactions yields no ratio; do not average per-post ratios. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged. Existing per-source/per-transaction floors are applied in integer wei before conversion to gwei; they are not rounded down to whole gwei.

targets.rawSql: WITH population AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.* FROM eez.settled_transaction_costs r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=r.l1_chain_id JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid), totals AS (SELECT l2_chain_id,rollup_id,count(*) AS posts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE denominator_status IN ('verified','reverted_post') AND accounting_gap IS NULL) AS measured_posts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE denominator_status NOT IN ('verified','reverted_post') OR accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS unmeasured_posts,sum(settled_transactions) FILTER(WHERE denominator_status IN ('verified','reverted_post') AND accounting_gap IS NULL) AS settled_transactions,sum(execution_paid+blob_paid) FILTER(WHERE denominator_status IN ('verified','reverted_post') AND accounting_gap IS NULL) AS measured_posting_wei FROM population GROUP BY l2_chain_id,rollup_id) SELECT l2_chain_id::text AS l2_context,rollup_id::text,posts,measured_posts,unmeasured_posts,settled_transactions::text,trim_scale((measured_posting_wei) * 0.000000001)::text AS measured_posting_gwei,trim_scale((trunc(measured_posting_wei/NULLIF(settled_transactions,0))) * 0.000000001)::text AS posting_per_settled_transaction_gwei FROM totals ORDER BY l2_chain_id

panels.title: Settled transaction denominator · coverage and exact per-post costs
panels.description: Per-post evidence status. Reverted posting fees remain charged with zero applied transactions; incomplete history and shared multi-rollup fees have unknown denominators. Exact monetary amounts are decimal gwei strings. A repeated range can have zero newly settled transactions despite a successful paid post. Monetary amounts/prices are exact decimal gwei strings (1 gwei = 10^9 wei), converted with numeric multiplication after accounting. Gas quantities and byte counts are unchanged. Existing per-source/per-transaction floors are applied in integer wei before conversion to gwei; they are not rounded down to whole gwei.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.l2_chain_id::text AS l2_context,r.rollup_id::text,'0x'||encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex') AS post_hash,r.denominator_status,r.settled_transactions::text,trim_scale((r.execution_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS execution_paid_gwei,trim_scale((r.blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS blob_paid_gwei,trim_scale((r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS total_paid_gwei,trim_scale((r.posting_wei_per_settled_transaction_floor) * 0.000000001)::text AS posting_per_settled_transaction_gwei FROM eez.settled_transaction_costs r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=r.l1_chain_id JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid ORDER BY r.block_number,r.transaction_index,r.l2_chain_id LIMIT 200

list.name: Native restart observations
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Native process epoch: '||e.liveness AS text,'restart' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_epoch_status e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND e.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200

list.name: Local policy dispositions
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Local disposition: '||t.claimed_outcome AS text,t.source->>'direction' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_local_policy_evidence t JOIN eez.lifecycle_coverage s USING(source_id) WHERE t.evidence_state='local_policy' AND s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND s.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200
